lines.text: Hey builders! Kopi here, with a KD Tech Daily DevDay special.
The big DevDay reveal: dots. Always-on agents, each with its own cloud computer and browser, wired into over four thousand apps.
GPT six point one Sol is here. It's built for agentic coding and computer use, at one fifth the price of Astra.
Ultrafast is a new speed tier, up to eight times faster in Codex. And a new Pro five hundred plan gets twenty-five times the Plus allowance.
Codex moves into the cloud, with reusable dev environments. The CLI now takes voice, and Code Review summarizes your changes.
And the Agents API can now use computers, operating software through its interface, with multi-agent support and tool calling.
That's DevDay, builders. Now go build something!
